proposed_widenings.name: ongoing_effect_class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics has phases but no operations field. Nature's Sanctuary creates a persistent area with per-turn ongoing effects (Half Cover while in area, resistance while in area), which requires OngoingOperation semantics (trigger + effect) attached to the area. That pattern only exists on SpellMechanics.ongoing_effect. Class features need an analogous family or an extended ActivatedAbilityMechanics with optional operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube... You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.cross_feature_pool
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation cost includes expending a use from Wild Shape's own use-count pool, not from Nature's Sanctuary's pool. ActivationResource only models the activating feature's own pool. A cross-feature pool reference variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend a use of your Wild Shape

proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance_from_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: grant_resistance requires a fixed DamageTypeRef. Nature's Ward grants a resistance that changes with terrain type at runtime. The ally benefit here is 'the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward' — a runtime cross-feature state reference with no fixed damage type at authoring time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric.saveAbilityFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: Half Cover grants +2 to AC and +2 to Dexterity saving throws specifically. modify_roll_numeric can express +2 to saving_throw rolls but has no saveAbilityFilter to restrict to Dex saves only. (modify_roll_advantage has saveAbilityFilter; modify_roll_numeric does not.)
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area

notes: Primary blocker is structural: ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no operations field, so there is no honest way to express 'while creatures are in this area, apply persistent effects.' The ongoing_effect family has this but is spell-only. The bonus-action repositioning (reposition_attachment atom exists) also requires on_caster_spends_action inside an OngoingOperation, compounding the structural gap. Even if the structural gap were resolved, the cross-feature Wild Shape resource expenditure and the Nature's Ward runtime resistance cross-reference would each require additional surface widenings.
